    Maximal suffixes and prefixes of contour paths (BO13a Lemma 6, case II) #

    • RayCat.exists_max_suffix: if f factors through the value of a suffix of a path v but not through the value of v, there is a split v = (p₁ e) p₂ with f factoring through p₂ but not through e p₂ (BO13a's "appropriate decomposition").
    • MulBasis.l6_not_prefix_w, l6_not_prefix_w': ρ does not factor through a nonempty prefix of the path β w, σ not through one of β' w'.

    0 < q.length → (∃ (g : z ⟶ w.out), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g (pathVal q) = f) → (¬∃ (g : z ⟶ x.out), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g (pathVal (p.comp q)) = f) → ∃ (w'' : RayVert P) (w' : RayVert P) (p₁ : Quiver.Path x w'') (e : w'' ⟶ w') (p₂ : Quiver.Path w' y), (p₁.cons e).comp p₂ = p.comp q ∧ 0 < p₂.length ∧ (∃ (g : z ⟶ w'.out), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g (pathVal p₂) = f) ∧ ¬∃ (g : z ⟶ w''.out), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (↑e) (pathVal p₂)) = f
